name: difflet
description: Net saved Git additions and deletions in your status bar, with a per-file breakdown.

gitWorkingTreeStats.alignment.description: Side of the status bar for both indicators. Changes apply without reloading.

gitWorkingTreeStats.priority.description: Position within the chosen side. Higher values place the indicators farther left. Other extensions affect the exact position. Deletions use this priority minus one.

gitWorkingTreeStats.includeUntracked.description: Count untracked files as added lines.

gitWorkingTreeStats.addedColor.description: Color of the added-lines indicator in the status bar. Leave empty to use the theme foreground.

gitWorkingTreeStats.removedColor.description: Color of the removed-lines indicator in the status bar. Leave empty to use the theme foreground.

gitWorkingTreeStats.addedPrefix.description: Optional label shown before the added-lines indicator. A space is inserted after the label.

gitWorkingTreeStats.removedPrefix.description: Optional label shown before the removed-lines indicator. A space is inserted after the label.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Git statistics run local Git processes and read repository files.

virtualWorkspaces.description: A filesystem-backed Git repository is required.

scripts.package: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/package.js
